Corneal melanoma is a distinct condition unrelated to the fungal keratitis described in the vignette and the provided leaf ID.
Corneal melanin deposition from topical epinephrine is unrelated to the condition described in the vignette and the provided leaf ID.
Prior pine processionary infection, although mentioned in the patient's history, is deemed unlikely to be the cause of the current condition and does not relate to the provided leaf ID.

Keratitis by more common Exophiala species could be considered a broader category that includes Exophiala xenobiotica keratitis, but the specific identification of Exophiala xenobiotica makes B3.1 the more precise match.
